Get started in minutes

  1. Install on your device or open the web app.
  2. Create an account and verify the email code.
  3. Turn on notifications under Delivery.
  4. In Chat, describe what you want watched or reminded.

Install on iPhone or iPad

Apple does not allow free public IPA installs outside the App Store. Until then, use the official Home Screen app:

  1. Open Safari (not Chrome).
  2. Go to the Notify web app.
  3. Tap the Share button.
  4. Tap Add to Home Screen → Add.
  5. Open Notify from the icon → enable notifications when asked.
Open web app in Safari

Install on Windows

  1. Open Notify in Chrome or Edge.
  2. Open the browser menu (⋮).
  3. Choose Install app / Apps → Install this site as an app.
  4. Launch Notify from the Start menu like any other program.
